mmu: Unicorn ARMv7-A CPU page-table walker; guest CP15 and page tables
limits: Each core runs 6 instructions per 54 MHz device tick, estimated, not measured: a Cortex-A7 at roughly 1.2 GHz gives about 22 per tick at one instruction per cycle, and 6 is a quarter of that. At 24 the X-T3 5.11 boot reads the pointer at 0x18181ec before another core sets it (at 0x33bd548) and halts in the exception reporter; at 6 it reaches the first-start language menu.
